scope: The composer's Generate button was an instance of Vidra Fresh / Compact full-width submit (1155:88145): a hard-coded pill (radius 999, 9px sides, 6px gap, no tokens) with no state variants and a 14px arrow. It was replaced with Vidra Fresh / Button (v2 set 1959:7702) Tone=Primary in the three Vidra Fresh / Composer controls layouts, the arrow was dropped, every screen instance was reset to the system states, and the old component was deleted.
approach: Read-only census first on all 20 pages: every nested submit (ids ending ;1236:91194, ;1236:91110, ;1482:89569) with its label, Show label, opacity, fills, strokes, override fields and prototype links, plus a search for detached look-alikes.
The three placements were swapped in place with swapComponent, so node ids, and therefore screen-level prototype links, were preserved.

Screen-level text-property overrides did not survive the swap (Label#1155:2 and Label#884:0 are different properties). Opacity, fill, stroke and reaction overrides on the instance root did survive. Each affected screen instance was reset with removeOverrides, then given its recorded label and state, and its captured links were re-applied.
Writes were one page at a time, each verified in the same script against the recorded label, state, fill token, opacity, strokes and links.
Application code is out of scope. This record is the only repository file added; no existing record was edited.
